title: Middle Eastern Chicken with Bulgur Pilaf and Toasted Almonds
summary: Juicy spiced chicken is served over a fragrant bulgur pilaf with onions, carrot and herbs, finished with crunchy toasted almonds. It’s a warming, balanced dinner with bright, savoury Middle Eastern flavours.
steps: Pat the chicken dry and season it with 1 teaspoon of the salt, the black pepper, 1 teaspoon of the cumin, 1 teaspoon of the paprika and the cinnamon.

Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes per side, then lower the heat and cook through until the juices run clear, about 8 to 10 minutes more depending on thickness. Transfer to a plate and keep warm.

Add the remaining olive oil to the pan. Cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic, remaining cumin, remaining paprika and the ground coriander. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the bulgur, then pour in the water and remaining salt. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low heat for about 12 minutes until the bulgur is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
While the bulgur cooks, toast the almonds in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes, shaking often, until golden and fragrant.
Fluff the bulgur with a fork, then stir through the parsley and lemon juice. Slice the chicken if desired and serve it on top of the pilaf with the toasted almonds scattered over the dish.
